{{Top|notoc=1}}
{{Quote|If I had a planet that was truly my homeworld, I wouldn't give it away. I'd want to be able to come back whenever I wanted.|A young Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Trail of the Jedi">''[[Jedi Quest: The Trail of the Jedi]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Tatooine_EotECR.png|thumb|right|250px|Tatooine, the homeworld of both Anakin and Luke Skywalker]]

'''Homeworld''', sometimes referred to as "'''home planet''',"<ref name="Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope">{{Film|IV}}</ref> was a term used to identify the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that a being was raised or born on, or migrated to,<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: The Desperate Mission">''[[The Last of the Jedi: The Desperate Mission]]'': [[Ferus Olin]]'' reflects: "He was not a native [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassan]], but he had adopted that world. It was his homeworld."</ref><ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]'': "[[Cut Lawquane/Legends|Cut's]] life changes when [[Clone Wars/Legends|the war]] he fled comes to his [[Saleucami/Legends|new homeworld]]"</ref> and in the case of [[Droid/Legends|droids]], where they were constructed. Many notable individuals, such as [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]<ref name="Children of the Jedi novel">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref> and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]],<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref> referred to the planets where they spent their childhood as their homeworld, despite the fact that they were born elsewhere. [[Natasi Daala]] referred to [[Irmenu|her birthworld]] as her homeworld, even though she grew up [[Botajef/Legends|elsewhere]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Curiously, [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], never revealed his homeworld.<ref name="Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

The term homeworld also referred to the home planet of a [[Species/Legends|species]]. Most species had a homeworld or home [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Some were found in many systems, while others, suchs as the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], had transplanted themselves to a new home.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'', p. xi</ref> There were thousands of such homeworlds throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Most of these planets had modern [[Spaceport/Legends|starports]], a sophisticated trader network and a high level of technology.<ref name="Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One]]''</ref> The term was also used to describe the homeworld of a culture, like the planet [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], the homeworld of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]],<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref> an ancient, warrior-based culture.<ref name="Rulebook">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

Members of some species, like the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]]<ref name="Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref> and the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]],<ref name="Republic Commando: True Colors">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref> rarely left their homeworld. Most [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]] never set foot on their homeworld, and instead spent most of their time on [[Ithorian Herdship|floating cities]] above [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]]. As a result, most of them were comfortable only on [[Starship/Legends|starships]] or other artificial constructs.<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies: The Ruins of Dantooine">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Ruins of Dantooine]]''</ref> [[Flakax]] who left their homeworld tended to become psychopaths.<ref name="Dark Nest III: The Swarm War">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref>

The [[Yevetha]] equivalent term was '''spawnworld'''.<ref name="Before the Storm">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref>
